why.bring: Only a set encoder has a bring head. wp-v1c matches wp-v1 on open sheets and is better with them closed.
why.in_battle_open: Passes in_battle_pass, which is scored on Open Team Sheets games. It ignores the opponent's sets, which costs nothing when the sheet shows them.
why.in_battle_closed: No model passes closed_sheet_pass. This is the best one there (0.5813, worst ECE 0.093 against the GBT's 0.5852 / 0.099), and the only family whose belief band means anything, because the GBT does not read the sets the band is drawn over.
